limitations: This overlaps previously counted stars and observations; do not add to survey unique-star totals.
All available successful observations are combined irrespective of individual-sector or earlier pooled scores.
The frozen search remains period0.5..40days and inherits all its sensitivity and systematic limits.
Reported and reconstructed errors are tagged separately; empirical adjacent differences do not calibrate red noise.
Pooled selection, detrenders, masks and per-sector support do not provide independent confirmation or a calibrated false-alarm probability.
